meta.name: Combat visuals manifest
meta.purpose: Maps combat context (and, from ticket 09, enemy/ally template key) to the art asset that renders it, so scenes/screens/combat.gd never hardcodes a path. See docs/combat-animation-vision.md §2.1/§6 and docs/ART-BIBLE.md.
meta.backdropRule: One entry per Combat.CANONICAL_CONTEXTS context (systems/combat.gd). 'image' is a res:// path to a 390x360 backdrop plate, or "" when no plate has been produced yet -- the stage then fills with the flat data/palette.json colour named by 'fallbackColor' instead.
meta.templateRule: Ticket 09: 'templates' keys other than 'default' are the seven cast subjects (docs/combat-animation-vision.md §3) resolved by scenes/screens/combat.gd's _enemy_template_key()/display-entry building -- 'player' (state.player), the recruited-ally contactId (e.g. 'archie'), the data/enemies.json raidGuards key (territorialScrapper/veinGuard/orichalchumDealer), 'homeRaidRaider' (GameData.ENEMY_HOME_RAID_RAIDER), and 'mugger' (any enemy with isMugging true, however many concurrent instances -- one sheet, reused). Each subject's 'idle' entry is {image, frameCount, fps}; an empty 'image' (every subject below, today) means no art has been produced yet -- CombatScreen.StageSlot falls back cleanly to the ticket-01 placeholder box, per-subject, not an error. 'default' is unrelated to this per-subject lookup -- it's ticket 10's own shared stand-in for hurt/dead/attack only, untouched by ticket 09.

default._note: TEMPORARY build-test stand-in (ticket 10) -- untouched asset-pack frames (assets/Gangsters_2), not final art, not palette-quantised. Only hurt/dead/attack still read this entry; idle no longer does (ticket 09 moved idle to the per-subject keys below).

territorialScrapper._note: Asset-pack sourced stand-in (assets/Gangsters_2/Idle.png, untouched, not palette-quantised), same convention as templates.default -- see that entry's own _note. Not final art.

orichalchumDealer._note: Asset-pack sourced stand-in (assets/Gangsters_3/Idle.png, untouched, not palette-quantised), same convention as templates.default -- see that entry's own _note. Not final art.
